tool_calls.name: propose_answer_program

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # identify the non-background, non-4 object
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (4,7)]
    if not pts:return g
    col=g[pts[0][0]][pts[0][1]]
    # clear it
    for i,j in pts:g[i][j]=7
    # target is the lower empty side; for the demonstrated arrangement it is right,
    # while with the 4s on TL/BR it is the lower-left quadrant.
    if any(i==0 and j==0 for i,j in [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==4]):
        # put object in lower-left, preserving its shape
        minr=min(i for i,j in pts); minc=min(j for i,j in pts)
        tr=h-(max(i for i,j in pts)-minr+1); tc=1
    else:
        tr=h-(max(i for i,j in pts)-min(i for i,j in pts)+1); tc=w-(max(j for i,j in pts)-min(j for i,j in pts)+1)-1
    dr=tr-min(i for i,j in pts); dc=tc-min(j for i,j in pts)
    for i,j in pts:
        ni,nj=i+dr,j+dc
        if 0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w:g[ni][nj]=col
    return g"}
